authority: Original Word remains authoritative; Chinese default is the explicit user override. Actual Meowdoku playtest informs feedback design but is not frozen formal Pawdoku parameters.

changes.implementation: Analyze only candidate, region topology and already found animals; highlight applicable region/row/column/adjacency cells and corresponding rule cards, connect visible conflicts and briefly show startled expressions. No solution lookup in explanation. Undoing the error clears its effects immediately; no visible conflict means no invented explanation.

Action-aware tap/undo/double-tap/axis-derived swipe hand guide, touch rings and dimmed non-target cells. Small-cell hand clamped within board; touch location remains actual target. Does not intercept inputs or change tutorial state.

Original generated neutral/blink/happy/startled atlas with transparent runtime anchor normalization, caching and old-image fallback. Accepted finds smile, mistakes and visible conflicting animals startle, one visible animal blinks every four seconds. Board owns one cancellable idle job and pauses for hidden/background/locked/tutorial/hint/reduced-motion states.

Committed positive score delta appears near the found cell; total score still pulses. Lost hearts split/fade. Presentation is bounded and session/visibility guarded, and changes no gameplay/reward ledger.
